MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
WHERE CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) < 1949 OR c.city_name <> 'Oklahoma City'
RETURN DISTINCT t.founded_year AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
